text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Phew! Finally done with today's training.
I'm
starving!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hm? Is that Biko running over there?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ah! Bono! Did you just finish practice?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I have a little left to go!
I'm also doing a
patrol of
the campus while I run!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
The shadows of evil lurk everywhere...
but worry
not! For I am here to
safeguard the peace of the
academy!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Biko... That's so buono! ☆ Could I join
you on
your patrol?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
It'd be better to have two people in case
a villain
actually appears, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The school's safe, but I understand why
she's concerned about a younger
student wandering alone in the dark. I
worry she might wear herself out if she
tags along, though...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The school's safe, but I understand why
she's concerned about a younger
student wandering alone in the dark. I
worry she might wear herself out if she
tags along, though...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Hishi Akebono gets in some
extra solo
training by jogging around the
school on patrol.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I see... It might affect my
performance
tomorrow if I run any more
today.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Okay then, Trainer! I'm counting on you
to help
maintain school peace! Good
luck!
